references.title: Niche Construction: The Neglected Process in Evolution
references.author: Odling-Smee, F. John and Laland, Kevin N. and Feldman, Marcus W.
references.note: Niche construction --- organisms actively modifying their own and others' selective environments. Cited by the source paper and used by the cell-environment-coupling-spatial flagship study, where a single cell reshapes the very nutrient gradient it depends on. Key `odling1996' follows the paper's own citation; the foundational 1996 statement is Odling-Smee, Laland \& Feldman, "Niche construction", Am. Nat. 147(4):641--648.

references.title: On the viability of composed systems (stub)
references.author: Beer, Randall D.
references.note: Stub key, cited by the source paper's autopoiesis discussion. Used by autopoiesis-spatial for the viability-bound reading of closure: viability bounds are constraints on a shared state that must be maintained for a composition to persist, so crossing the bound (breaking the membrane so nothing is enclosed) shuts off the closure-gated maintenance that keeps the composition alive. references.title: The chemical basis of morphogenesis (stub)
references.author: Turing, Alan M.
